niche.habitat: Lane borders, dune bases, and evaporite pavements near salt flats.
niche.diet: Omnivore; scavenges carcasses, hunts small invertebrates, licks mineral crusts.
niche.active: Crepuscular; avoids midday heat and night frost.

body: Quadrupedal body with a low center of gravity. Front limbs are bulky, capsule-like structures housing 'Wheel-Capsules'. These capsules can detach and roll independently. Rear limbs are robust walking legs.

chains.trait: Front limbs are detachable symbiotic wheel-capsules.
links: Predators (Skirls/Sumpers) ambush on Lanes
Rolling escape is faster than walking
Evolution produced front limbs that are symbiotic rolling colonies
Symbiont can detach from host girdle and roll autonomously
Detached limb acts as a decoy, distracting predator

skill.effect: Detach a front wheel-capsule. Capsule rolls away in a random direction for 3 seconds, attracting aggro. Host gains 'Light Load' (move speed +30%) but loses forward attack capability.

chains.weakness: Decoy Vulnerability: If the player or enemy captures the rolling leg, the symbiont can be killed. Dead symbiont cannot be reattached, requiring regrowth.
observe: Front limbs have visible seams and pulsing tissue at the joint.
On threat, host slams front down and releases limb with a wet pop.
Detached leg rolls smoothly, surface rippling as symbiont moves.

journal.en: It trades a limb for its life, and grows a new one by dawn.

chains.trait: Rolling gait via host propulsion of symbiont.
links: Wheel-capsule is symbiont, not driven axle
Symbiont has no motor, only mobility cilia
Host pushes symbiont forward against ground
Symbiont cilia grip and roll the capsule
Gives 3x walking speed on hard Lanes

skill.effect: Host pushes front legs to roll. Speed triples for 3 seconds. Cost: Stamina drain. Can be used to dodge projectiles.

chains.weakness: Loose Sand: Symbiont cilia cannot grip loose sand or soft dunes. Rolling fails, and host must switch to walking.
observe: Host pushes forward with shoulders to drive the wheels.
Wheel surfaces show rapid ciliary motion under the translucent rim.
No drive shafts or gears visible.

journal.en: It runs by throwing its feet.

links: Symbiont is a complex colony
Detached symbiont cannot regenerate instantly
Host must build new capsule over hours
Metabolic drain during regrowth reduces host stats
Low gravity makes regrowth cheaper than on Earth, but still costly

skill.effect: Spend time to regrow a lost wheel-capsule. Restores limb and heals host. Can be used to 'befriend' other Rodapiés by offering symbiont fragments (speculative).

chains.weakness: Regrowth Vulnerability: During regrowth, Rodapié has only one functional wheel and reduced movement. Aggressive players can interrupt this process.
observe: Missing front limb shows a weeping wound that slowly fills with tissue.
Host rests in sheltered hollows while regrowing.
Regrown limb is smaller and paler initially.

journal.en: The price of speed is paid in flesh.

links: Lanes are islands separated by dunes
Wheels trap in loose sand
Host retains walking legs
Rodapié can lift wheel-capsules and walk
Walking is slow but essential for inter-Lane travel

skill.effect: Lift wheel-capsules. Rodapié walks at normal speed on dunes. Cannot use Roll Burst. Symbionts are safe but vulnerable to attack.

chains.weakness: Slow Travel: Portaging is essential for crossing dunes but makes Rodapié a slow target for chases.
observe: Host tucks wheels against belly when crossing dunes.
Rear legs do all the work; front limbs are held aloft.
Symbionts pulse weakly while tucked, conserving energy.

journal.en: It walks the desert, wheels tucked like a turtle's head.

relations.note: (council kind 'Predator') Skirls stoop on Rodapiés. Dropping a leg can confuse the stoop, causing the Skirl to strike the decoy or miss.
(council kind 'Commensal') Karrow skid-lines leave brine residue that Rodapiés lick; Rodapiés disturb dust that Karrow senses for navigation.

body_plan.origin: Quadrupedal ancestor that specialized in rapid limb detachment and regrowth.

temperament: Skittish and defensive; plays dead then bolts.
secrets: Symbiont fragments can be transferred: A wounded Rodapié may allow a conspecific to 'graft' a fragment of its symbiont to repair a damaged leg, creating a bond.
Rolling legs retain a fragment of host memory: Captured legs may roll toward their original host if hummed to.
moments: A Rodapié senses a shadow overhead. With a wet crack, it slams its front down, releasing a pulsating wheel that rolls away into the dunes. The host walks calmly on its rear legs, the detached limb rolling frantically in the distance, drawing the Skirl's attention.

journal.en: Four legs, two of which can run away.
The road claims a limb, the host pays the debt.
